## Context / Problem

The shared checkout contained an uncommitted `.codex/config.toml` adjustment for Serena `write_memory`, which prevented a clean fast-forward to `origin/main`. The adjustment needed to move into an isolated worktree and land through Gerrit without disturbing unrelated work.

Official Codex documentation at https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp#other-configuration-options defines `tools.<tool>.approval_mode` as the per-tool MCP approval override and lists `approve` among the supported approval modes. Project-local `.codex/config.toml` is loaded only for trusted projects.

## Approach

- Add `[mcp_servers.serena.tools.write_memory]` with `approval_mode = "approve"` to `.codex/config.toml`.
- Validate the exact parsed value and run Codex with `--strict-config` so an unknown key fails rather than being ignored.
- Preserve the existing Serena server configuration and land the isolated one-file change through Gerrit.

## Scope / File Impact

- `.codex/config.toml` only.
- The unrelated shared-checkout `src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py` work was not modified.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] [code-verifiable] Parsing `.codex/config.toml` yields `mcp_servers.serena.tools.write_memory.approval_mode == "approve"`.
- [x] [code-verifiable] `codex --strict-config --version` accepts the project configuration.
- [x] [code-verifiable] The landed commit changes only `.codex/config.toml`.
- [x] [code-verifiable] The landed diff adds only the `mcp_servers.serena.tools.write_memory` table and its `approval_mode` value.
- [x] [code-verifiable] The existing Serena `command`, `args`, `startup_timeout_sec`, and `enabled` values are unchanged.
- [x] [code-verifiable] Repository lint passes by exit code from the worktree virtualenv.
- [x] [code-verifiable] Repository typecheck passes by exit code from the worktree virtualenv.
- [x] [operator-attested] Gerrit change 1264 has `LLM-Review +1`.
- [x] [operator-attested] Gerrit change 1264 has `Verified +1`.
- [x] [operator-attested] Gerrit change 1264 has zero unresolved comments before Submit.
